description: ATAK_Phone runs Iceman_fnc_phone_tick from a 0.5 s CBA per-frame handler with a bare call, so phone_tick's bare call to Iceman_fnc_phone_myRadio receives the handler's [args, handle] array and its params rejects it. Every client logged two script errors a second and the phone never found its radio from that loop. The call now passes the player explicitly.
